0022600210.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-6, 1-3 on the road, on a two-game losing streak and 11th in the West) visit the Golden State Warriors (7-3, winners of seven straight and 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back), with the teams yet to meet this season. New Orleans is missing Trendon Watford (ankle), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis), Yves Missi (knee bruise), and Zion Williamson (rest), while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), and Gary Payton II (knee) and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, but the Pelicans won the most recent meeting 113-109 in New Orleans on February 24, 2026.
